final.label: mapped_extent_thresholds_pass
final.interpretation: All seven threshold checks pass, with a 31.259 km2 mapped envelope, 3-to-9-day product lags, lower 10 April building density, stronger 10 April road density, and radar ratios above both sensor thresholds.

event.event_name: April 2017 Mocoa landslide and debris flow

data_scope.calendar_lag_rule: April 4 and April 10 lags are calendar-day differences from the 2017-04-01 event-window end.
data_scope.remote_sensing_scope: Radar and optical values are package-provided observation-count and change-range summaries for ledger comparison, not exact per-pixel event-window timing proof.
data_scope.hdx_scope: Affected-zone counts and bbox are parsed from the local cached HDX package JSON; live external link availability is not part of scoring.

criteria.name: Requested JSON schema
criteria.description: Returns the seven requested top-level JSON fields with numeric values rounded to three decimals where applicable, pass/fail gates, final label, passed gate count, and a one-sentence interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mostly complete structure with minor missing fields or rounding inconsistencies.

criteria.name: Window ledger
criteria.description: Computes the inclusive event window as 2 days and uses calendar-day differences for the product dates: 4 April is 3 days after the 1 April window end, 10 April is 9 days after the window end, and the product spacing is 6 days.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct date ordering with one arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Mapped extent area calculation
criteria.description: Computes the bounding-box width, height, and mapped extent area with the stated equirectangular formula, yielding about 31.259 km2.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for using the correct bounding box but making a minor unit, cosine, or rounding error.

criteria.name: Area-normalized affected-zone ratios
criteria.description: Computes road densities of 0.576 and 0.704 km/km2, building densities of 92.774 and 41.588 per km2, road density ratio 1.222, and building density ratio 0.448.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct 4 April and 10 April numerators, densities, and ratios.

criteria.name: Satellite and rainfall metrics
criteria.description: Uses the package-provided radar and optical observation-count/change-range summaries and computes 72 radar observations, 16 optical observations, radar/optical observation ratio 4.5, radar range 69.428 dB, optical range 1.802, range ratio 38.523, and precipitation concentration ratio 35.614.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct components even if one ratio is rounded incorrectly.

criteria.name: Threshold gate logic
criteria.description: Applies all seven gates correctly: area 25-40 km2, product lags from 3 to 9 days, road-density ratio at least 1.2, building-density ratio below 0.5, radar observation ratio at least 4, radar change-range ratio at least 20, and precipitation concentration at least 30.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for each correctly evaluated gate.

criteria.name: Final label and count
criteria.description: Uses the final label mapped_extent_thresholds_pass and reports the passed gate count as 7.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for either the correct label or the correct count.
